expr: (() => { const S=window.simState; return S.A===200 && S.d===2 && S.U0===1 && S.eriste==='ilma' && S.lahde==='kytketty' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: on load: A = 200 cm2, d = 2,0 mm, U0 = 1,0 kV, air, connected (must run before any setup)
on load: C = 8,854e-12 · 0,0200 m2 : 0,0020 m = 88,5 pF (lesson-answers sim-C)
on load: Q = C U0 = 88,5 nC (sim-Q)
on load: U = U0 = 1,0 kV
on load: E = U : d = 0,50 MV/m (sim-E)
on load: W = 1/2 Q U = 44,3 µJ (sim-W)
on load: no breakdown

expr: (() => { const R=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root input[type=range]'); const ok=(r,a,b,s)=>r.min===a&&r.max===b&&r.step===s; return R.length===3 && ok(R[0],'1','10','0.5') && ok(R[1],'100','400','50') && ok(R[2],'0','4','0.1') ? 1 : 0 })()
note: three sliders: d 1,0-10,0 mm by 0,5; A 100-400 cm2 by 50; U0 0-4,0 kV by 0,1
two selects: the dielectric (air, teflon, paper, glass) and the source (connected, disconnected)
DOM order canvas, controls, readout

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words

expr: (() => { const P=window.simAdapter && window.simAdapter.params; return P && Object.keys(P).sort().join(',')==='A,U0,d,eriste,lahde' && P.d.unit==='mm' && P.U0.unit==='kV' ? 1 : 0 })()
note: adapter declares d (mm), A (cm2), U0 (kV), eriste and lahde

expr: (() => { const c=document.querySelector('#sim-root canvas'); const w=document.getElementById('sim-root').clientWidth; return c.width===600 && c.height===(w<500?1040:400) ? 1 : 0; })()
note: canvas 600x400 on a wide screen, 600x1040 (plates and graph stacked, larger labels) under 500 px
the readout shows the capacitance, the energy and the breakdown strength
